name: pict-covertable
description: Syntax highlighting, diagnostics, and covering-array generation for Microsoft PICT model files, powered by the covertable engine.

pict.strength.markdownDescription: Combinatorial order (`/o`). 2 = pairwise, 3 = triple-wise, etc. A per-file `{ ... } @ N` sub-model still overrides this for its factors.

enumDescriptions: Greedy row construction — packs the most uncovered combinations into each row (fewest rows).
Simple criterion — lighter, less aggressive packing.
Random ordering of candidate pairs (varies between runs).
pict.sorter.description: Order in which candidate combinations are considered.

pict.caseSensitive.description: Match constraint comparisons and alias lookups case-sensitively. When off (default), matching is case-insensitive.

pict.optimize.enable.markdownDescription:
After generating, run a **simulated-annealing** post-process that shrinks the covering array further (same coverage, fewer rows). Off by default; it trades wall-clock time (`pict.optimize.budgetMs`) for a smaller result.

**⚠️ Ignores `weights`.** Optimization rewrites cell values freely to remove rows, so it **flattens** any value weighting (`Value (N)` in the model) — it preserves only coverage and constraints, not how often each value appears. Leave this off if you rely on weighted value distribution.

pict.optimize.budgetMs.markdownDescription: Time budget (ms) for the optimizer. It is *anytime* — it returns the smallest array found so far when the budget elapses. Larger = potentially fewer rows. Only used when `pict.optimize.enable` is on.

pict.optimize.workers.markdownDescription: Number of parallel worker threads for the optimizer (cooperative island model). `> 1` keeps the editor responsive during optimization and reliably finds a better result; `1` runs single-threaded (may briefly block). Only used when `pict.optimize.enable` is on.

pict.output.format.description: Column separator used for the generated result document.

pict.output.includeHeader.description: Include a header row with the parameter names.

pict.output.promptFileName.markdownDescription: Ask for the output file name before generating (pre-filled with `<model>.tsv`/`.csv`). Turn off to open the result directly with the default name.

pict.diagnostics.enable.description: Report parse errors (unknown references, malformed constraints, etc.) as editor diagnostics.
